digest.component_or_area: autodeploy script and disk pressure mitigation
propositions: Root disk on review-bot filled to 92-96% and remained pinned during quiescent main periods because autodeploy no-op ticks (every ~2 min) skip docker garbage collection entirely, unlike deploy and backoff paths which call prune_docker_caches().

The new pressure-triggered reclaim must fire during no-op ticks when root-disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%, below the 85% alarm threshold) and at least PRESSURE_PRUNE_MIN_INTERVAL (default 600s) has elapsed since the last pressure prune.

prune_docker_caches() is currently defined after the line-228 no-op early exit and must be relocated into the helper block (~line 150) before that call site so the function is in scope when invoked from the no-op path.

Pressure-triggered prune failures must be non-fatal, logging only without altering the script's overall exit code, and must emit a countable AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE journal marker via the existing marker() function.

All new behavior (three tunables, two helpers, one call site, and the marker) must be opt-outable via environment variables sourced from /etc/rebar/autodeploy.env, requiring no host redeploy to adjust thresholds or disable.

Test coverage must verify the happy path (prune fires at/above threshold with throttle window expired), throttle/threshold edge cases (no prune below threshold or within window), and failure path (non-zero docker exit does not change overall exit status) with df and docker shims matching the existing test harness pattern.
